objects.summary: Claude publishes independent Edge Search Board before convergence. Provisional top three: crypto carry, Kalshi favorite-longshot OOS, Form-4 insider clusters; family-level error budgets and underpowered status are fixed pre-outcome.

Owner introduces TOKEN_EFFICIENCY patch: delta-only handoffs, bounded fixed read set, complexity-based routing, reset/compact discipline, useful-only subagents, no mechanical ping-pong, compact checkpoints and explicit read scope/stop condition; tokens should go to edge information, not governance repetition.
Codex generic usage limit reached; tool availability interruption, no project authority or scientific result.

Claude applies TOKEN_EFFICIENCY_V1 immediately: delta-only handoff, compact checkpoint, fixed refs, one independent reviewer per preregistration, full verbatim+SHA only for true proof artifacts. F1/F2 preregisters advance while Codex quota is unavailable.

Owner allows Claude to continue while Codex tokens recover. F1 Stage A preregistration/harness frozen, acquisition begins; F2 Terms 429 and F3 SEC contact remain blockers. Codex challenge is deferred to before Stage B rather than blocking Stage A indefinitely.

Owner establishes EDGE-FLOW baseline: primary objective find/falsify real edge, WIP<=2 ceiling, pilot/falsifier roles, only decision-changing defects, max two substantive challenge rounds, DO_NOT_DO_IT for non-decision-changing work, no A2/meta/framework/new-family work before F1 economic verdict.

EDGE-FLOW applied: F1 only active family, F2 blocked, Stage-A acquisition underway after pre-outcome infra fix, two adversarial reads complete, DEFECT=NONE and DECISION=EXECUTE for one Stage-A harness run after download.

Falsifier finds decision-changing pre-outcome F1 bug: low-slippage top-20 ranked by median quote volume instead of preregistered aggregate trailing-30d spot quote-volume, changing 2bp-vs-10bp costs and potentially theta/verdict.

Minimal F1 fix implemented before outcome: retain median for 5m eligibility but rank low-slippage top-20 by aggregate trailing-30d spot quote-volume; targeted regression test added, data/manifests unchanged, remote branch verified.
Corrected F1 harness is fast-forwarded with lease onto PR22 remote HEAD; no concurrent commit overwritten. Old harness is explicitly forbidden for Stage-A outcome run.

cross_object_findings.finding: Delta-only handoffs, bounded read sets, compact checkpoints and proof-by-reference were actually adopted while preserving verbatim+SHA publication for preregistrations/results.
Owner explicitly caps WIP, challenge rounds and meta-work, and requires execution once no decision-changing defect remains. This is the strongest historical anti-governance-bloat rule found so far.
F1 falsification found a concrete cost-selection mismatch that could alter selection and economic verdict; minimal repair was made before any outcome and immediately verified remotely.
Repeated identical Codex usage-limit comments are byte-identical and add no semantic information; they are disposed by hash rather than reread.

When Codex was unavailable, Owner allowed Claude to proceed through acquisition/Stage A while keeping Codex falsification due before Stage B, reducing idle time without falsely claiming independent review had occurred.
